title: Hostel D Renovation Funds Approved
body: Contrary to rumors of budget cuts, the VC's office has officially signed off on the 50M Naira allocation for Hostel D plumbing and electrical overhauls starting next semester.

title: Library Extension Hours Permanent
body: The 24/7 library access trialed during the last exam period has been made permanent for all registered undergraduates, effective immediately.

title: Tech Fee Hike for Freshmen
body: Rumors circulating on WhatsApp about a 20k mandatory "tech integration fee" for incoming students are entirely false. No such fee exists in the current approved senate budget.
